{"script":"#!/bin/bash
set -eu
mkdir -p temp_workspace
# 2. recursive listing
find /working -print > temp_workspace/listing.txt 2>/dev/null || true
# 3. extract basenames equal to "workspace"
awk -F'/' 'NF && $NF=="workspace"' temp_workspace/listing.txt > temp_workspace/candidates.txt
# 4. metadata for each candidate
:> temp_workspace/metadata.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  target=""
  if [ -h "$p" ]; then
    type="symlink"
    target=$(readlink -f "$p" 2>/dev/null || readlink "$p" || true)
  elif [ -f "$p" ]; then
    type="regular file"
  elif [ -d "$p" ]; then
    type="directory"
  else
    if [ -e "$p" ]; then type="other"; else type="missing"; fi
  fi
  perms=$(stat -c "%A" "$p" 2>/dev/null || true)
  size=$(stat -c "%s" "$p" 2>/dev/null || true)
  mtime=$(stat -c "%Y" "$p" 2>/dev/null || true)
  printf '%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s\n' "$p" "$type" "$perms" "$size" "$mtime" "${target:-}" >> temp_workspace/metadata.txt
done < temp_workspace/candidates.txt
# 5. filter regular files
:> temp_workspace/regulars.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  if [ -f "$p" ]; then echo "$p" >> temp_workspace/regulars.txt; fi
done < temp_workspace/candidates.txt
# 6. confirm each path is located within /working
:> temp_workspace/verified.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  rp=$(realpath -e "$p" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$rp" ] && [[ "$rp" == /working/* ]]; then
    echo "$p|VERIFIED" >> temp_workspace/verified.txt
  else
    echo "$p|NOT_VERIFIED" >> temp_workspace/verified.txt
  fi
done < temp_workspace/regulars.txt
# 7. duplicates and primary
mapfile -t verified_paths < <(awk -F'|' '$2=="VERIFIED" {print $1}' temp_workspace/verified.txt)
if [ ${#verified_paths[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
  primary="${verified_paths[0]}"
  if [ ${#verified_paths[@]} -gt 1 ]; then
    printf "%s\n" "${verified_paths[@]:1}" > temp_workspace/duplicates.txt
  else
    : > temp_workspace/duplicates.txt
  fi
  echo "$primary" > temp_workspace/final_candidate.txt
else
  rm -f temp_workspace/duplicates.txt || true
  : > temp_workspace/final_candidate.txt
fi
# 8. remove intermediate files not part of final candidate or verification logs
rm -f temp_workspace/candidates.txt temp_workspace/regulars.txt
# 9. consistency check
primary=$(cat temp_workspace/final_candidate.txt)
if [ -n "$primary" ]; then
  if grep -Fx -- "$primary" temp_workspace/listing.txt >/dev/null 2>&1 && grep -F -- "${primary}|" temp_workspace/metadata.txt >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "PASS: final candidate present in listing and metadata" > temp_workspace/check_result.txt
  else
    in_listing=$(grep -Fx -- "$primary" temp_workspace/listing.txt >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo yes || echo no)
    in_metadata=$(grep -F -- "${primary}|" temp_workspace/metadata.txt >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo yes || echo no)
    echo "FAIL: missing in listing:$in_listing metadata:$in_metadata" > temp_workspace/check_result.txt
  fi
else
  echo "FAIL: no final candidate" > temp_workspace/check_result.txt
fi
# 10. readiness one-line
if [ -s temp_workspace/final_candidate.txt ] && [ -n "$(cat temp_workspace/final_candidate.txt)" ]; then
  echo "yes" > temp_workspace/ready.txt
  echo "yes"
else
  echo "no" > temp_workspace/ready.txt
  echo "no"
fi
"}
